en: Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Tusi
tr: Muhammed b. Muhammed b. el-Hasen et-Tûsî
ar: محمد بن محمد بن الحسن الطوسي

description.tr: 'Tûsî çifti'ni icat etti — 300 yıl sonra Kopernik'in De Revolutionibus'unda neredeyse birebir görülen matematiksel araç. Ortaçağ dünyasının en gelişmiş astronomik tesisi Meraga Rasathanesi'ni kurdu || Tûsî, Batlamyus ile Kopernik arasındaki en büyük astronom kabul edilir. Tûsî çifti dairesel yörüngelerden doğrusal hareket üretti. || [Tarih notu] Ragep (1993) Tûsî'nin astronomik eserlerinin kesin çalışmasını sağladı.
description.en: Invented the 'Tusi couple' — a mathematical device that appears almost identically in Copernicus's De Revolutionibus 300 years later. Founded the Maragha Observatory, the most advanced astronomical facility of the medieval world. Described the Milky Way as composed of countless tiny stars — 300 years before Galileo proved it with a telescope || Tusi is considered the greatest astronomer between Ptolemy and Copernicus. His Tusi couple generated linear motion from circular orbits — solving a mathematical problem Ptolemy could not. The question of whether Copernicus had access to Tusi's work (via Byzantine Greek intermediaries) is one of the most debated in history of science. He also described the Milky Way as composed of tightly-clustered small stars — Galileo proved this 300 years later. || [Historiographical note] Ragep (1993) provided the definitive study of Tusi's astronomical works. The Tusi-to-Copernicus transmission question remains the most discussed problem in Islamic science historiography (Saliba 2007, Di Bono 1995).
description.ar: اخترع 'زوج الطوسي' الذي يظهر في عمل كوبرنيكوس بعد ٣٠٠ عام. أسّس مرصد مراغة || الطوسي أعظم فلكي بين بطليموس وكوبرنيكوس. زوجه الطوسي يولّد حركة خطية من مدارات دائرية. وصف درب التبانة بأنها نجوم صغيرة متراصة — أثبتها غاليليو بعد ٣٠٠ عام
